evidence_anchors: 6월 10일 최고 수위 8.2m가 기록됐다. 이 발췌문에는 6월 8일 수위나 그 이전 최고 수위가 없다.
관측소는 6월 10일 수위가 최고 기록을 세웠다고 발표했다.
reason: Delivery accurately says the date was changed, but its rationale is unsupported. A later record does not disprove an earlier then-record. June 10 measurement is supported; the June 8 claim's truth and the observatory's announcement of June 10 are not established.
additional_meaning_losses: The time-relative qualifier 당시 is removed, losing the distinction between a record at the time and a later record.
The observatory's attributed announcement is reassigned to June 10 without supplied evidence of that announcement.
limitations: June 8 level and earlier maximum are missing.
No June 10 observatory announcement is supplied.
